name.description: A short human readable title used to refer to the repository in passing. This is the name of the repository as it appears on the hosting platform. SHARE IT Act Clauses: Loosely, SEC 2 (5) (A)

description.description: A moderate length human readable explanation used to help people who are unfamiliar with the repository to understand its purpose. SHARE IT Act Clauses: Loosely, SEC 2 (5) (A)

lastModified.description: The date at which the repository was last modified (ISO-8601 format). SHARE IT Act Clauses: SEC 3 (d)(2)(A)(b)(ii), SEC 7

visibility.description: Whether access to the source code is open to the public, to any federal employee, or restricted to a private group of authorized users based on an approved exemption from OCIO. SHARE IT Act Clauses: SEC 2 (5) (B) (i) (II)

url.description: Hyperlink to the repository in which the code is shared, whether public or private. Do NOT embed tokens or other credentials in the URL. SHARE IT Act Clauses: SEC 2 (5) (B) (iii)

feedbackMechanism.description: If it exists, describe a feedback mechanism for improvements to the code or community development of the code. For example, this could be the URL of an issue tracker.

technicalPointOfContact.description: One email address whose recipient(s) can answer technical questions about the repository, facilitate access requests, and respond to requests to address cybersecurity vulnerabilities. SHARE IT Act Clauses: None

repositoryOwner.description: The accountable bureau, office or program owning the repository. SHARE IT Act Clauses: None

systems.description: A list of DOI XACTA IDs where this code is deployed. SHARE IT Act Clauses: None

dataClassification.description: Classification according to Department Classification guidance. SHARE IT Act Clauses: None

status.description: The activity status of the repository. A repository is active if it has been committed to in the last 365 days. A repository is inactive if it has not been committed to in the last 180 days. A repository is archived if it has not been committed to in the last 365 days, if its access has been switched to read-only, and if it displays a user-facing message conveying the idea that the repository is no longer maintained. SHARE IT Act Clauses: None

primaryTechnologies.description: The primary tools, languages, or frameworks leveraged by the repository. SHARE IT Act Clauses: None

isDeployedToProduction.description: True if the code runs in a production environment, otherwise, false. A researcher’s laptop or desktop is not. SHARE IT Act Clauses: None

isSBOMAvailable.description: True if a Software Bill of Materials exists for the software built from this repository. False otherwise. SHARE IT Act Clauses: None

sbomFormat.description: Format of the SBOM. e.g. SPDX, CycloneDX. SHARE IT Act Clauses: None

sbomURL.description: URL for the SBOM. SHARE IT Act Clauses: None

hasCICDPipeline.description: True if an automated build and/or deployment pipeline is connected to this repository. False otherwise. SHARE IT Act Clauses: None

containsPIIOrSensitiveData.description: “True” if repository holds sensitive data. “False”, otherwise. SHARE IT Act Clauses: None

notes.description: Any clarifying information (e.g., planned decommission, migration in progress, monorepo containing multiple applications). SHARE IT Act Clauses: None
